items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: William Houston Junior was my aunts' boyfriend... by Mr. Houston coming to the house a lot of time... he said, I give you permission to go in on and play.

ctx.x: Always. From a young man. From a young man. From the day I left that show, seeing a little kid on top of the piano playing the trumpet, I wanted to play music. Because people who visited my house, you see we had a family that lived all together, my aunts, my uncles, my grandmother, my grandfather, my mother, my father, and all these. So they had, and these older aunts, they went to Zav University and they also went to Dillard University. And in those days they had musicians like William Houston, William Houston…
